Iran warns US, allies against new attack, threatens retaliation
item.description: Iran has reiterated its commitment to retaliate against the United States and its allies for any major offensive, citing credible intelligence indicating such actions are imminent. In response, President Donald Trump has issued a stern warning to Tehran about potential severe repercussions. The recent violence, including attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi sites, has aggravated tensions and disrupted regional energy supplies and maritime operations.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: A NJ family has owned a 135-acre Christmas tree farm for 80 years; the preserved property...
item.description: On the market is a remarkable 135-acre Christmas tree farm in Warren County, New Jersey, a family-owned gem for eighty years. This unique estate features a stunning 1839 timber-frame barn and a charming guest cottage. With farmland preservation in place, buyers can ensure this agricultural haven remains untouched by urban growth, and the sale includes necessary equipment and established customer pathways.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Meet Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, eighth-grader who is competing for $100,000 in STEM awards
item.description: An eighth-grade student from Pennsylvania, Sai Sri Valli Mogilineedi, has become a national finalist for her groundbreaking GERD drug delivery system. She created an innovative controlled release mechanism aimed at prolonging the effectiveness of antacid medications. This recognition follows her success at regional science fairs, and she will vie for educational accolades in Washington, D.C. in October, showcasing her dedication to improving heartburn treatment outcomes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Trump to meet NYC Mayor Mamdani at Gracie Mansion during NYC visit for UNGA
item.description: President Donald Trump will meet New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on Monday. The meeting will focus on issues affecting New York City and its residents. This encounter occurs as New York hosts nearly 130 world leaders for the UN General Assembly. Wars in the Middle East and Ukraine are major issues confronting the gathering. Concerns over artificial intelligence also remain a significant global topic.
item.dc:creator: Trisha Mahajan

item.title: A New York couple built their 2,500-sq-ft home for $40,000 using YouTube and discarded materials
item.description: After building a budget-friendly home in New York for just $40,000 and selling it for a striking $290,000, a couple made a spontaneous decision to relocate to Florida. Without job commitments in place, Jessica Patrzyk transitioned into real estate, while her husband chased his passion as a diving instructor. As they explore Florida’s delights and face new career paths, they also navigate the complexities of stricter local building codes.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 2016, Michael Dell paid $10.9 million for a Boston penthouse; 10 years later the barely used...
item.description: Michael Dell's luxurious penthouse in Boston is hitting the auction block with a starting bid of $6.5 million. Initially acquired for $10.9 million a decade ago, this stunning property is situated on the 59th floor of the renowned Millennium Tower. Following several attempts at traditional sale routes, Dell has opted for an auction format that wraps up in late October, making it a must-watch event for high-end real estate enthusiasts.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A Wyoming-to-Canada wildlife project has supported 204 crossings and helped protect 59 million acres
item.description: A conservation project connecting wild habitats from Wyoming to Canada's Yukon is a finalist for Prince William's Earthshot Prize. The Yellowstone to Yukon initiative protects 59 million acres and supports 204 wildlife crossings. This project brings together diverse groups to build safe passage for animals across highways. Indigenous communities manage about one-quarter of the protected land within the corridor. The initiative plans to protect another 50 million acres by 2030.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: In 1992, Elton John began buying Atlanta apartments and combined six into a 13,000-square-foot home
item.description: Sir Elton John's expansive Atlanta residence has been sold for $7.225 million. This high-rise property was strategically priced to attract multiple competitive offers. The combined six apartments were developed over thirty years into a luxurious sky mansion. John used this home as his primary North American base during his touring years. The sale concludes the transfer of the largest residential space in the Park Place tower.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: After grandmother loses sight, teen builds $170 AI glasses
item.description: Seventeen-year-old Alexander Du has made waves with his creation, IRIS, an AI-powered wearable aimed at aiding the visually impaired. This device uses vibration technology to assist users in navigation and obstacle detection, providing a cost-effective alternative to pricey commercial smart glasses. His remarkable efforts were acknowledged in a ceremony at the White House, as he aspires to expand IRIS's reach to countless individuals worldwide.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Florida is sinking 3 million pounds of repurposed concrete culverts off Destin-Fort Walton Beach
item.description: In an innovative approach, old concrete pipes are being repurposed as artificial reefs in the Gulf of Mexico. This initiative will create three new underwater habitats near Destin-Fort Walton Beach. These structures offer vital shelter for various marine species and bolster local fisheries. Additionally, this project enhances Florida's Coastal Corridor program by linking essential marine ecosystems, benefiting charter boats, fishermen, and scuba divers alike.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 1887 winery hidden for decades now part of $35M Napa estate
item.description: A 151-acre Napa Valley vineyard property is now for sale at thirty-five million dollars. This historic estate features a restored 1887 stone winery and about twenty-five acres of vineyards. The property includes a recently built main house and a private lake with a small cabin. Artist Matt Rogers is selling the land his father purchased years ago. Ellen DeGeneres and Portia previously considered buying this unique Napa Valley property.
item.dc:creator: TOI Real Estate Desk

item.title: In 2022, Adele bought Sylvester Stallone’s 3.5-acre Beverly Park mansion for $58 million; four years...
item.description: In a bold real estate move, Adele bought Sylvester Stallone's stunning Beverly Hills home for $58 million in 2022. Her plans? A total demolition and rebuild of the luxurious estate, while preserving the iconic Rocky Balboa bronze statue that adds a unique flair to the deal. With a modern design featuring expansive glass panels, this renovation is set to reshape the property over the next few years.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘When do I blow entire nation up?' Trump's ultimatum after Iran warns of 'decisive war'
item.description: President Trump warned Iran of serious consequences if it does not change course. He outlined options including destruction, economic collapse, or diplomacy with Iran. Iran's command stated any US attack would face retaliation without limitations. Iran relayed truce conditions to the US through Qatari mediators. Trump signaled openness to talks with Iranian President Pezeshkian.
